subject: Help with Cluster Robust Standard Error

messages.author: f05f42a43415188b
messages.subject: Help with Cluster Robust Standard Error
parts:
Hi Guys,

I was wondering if lavaan can do cluster robust SE like Mplus. The code in Mplus is pretty simple with Cluster=clustervariable and type=complex.

Is there a way we can do this with lavaan? 

Thanks!

messages.author: b8fd92e5e3662745
messages.subject: Re: Help with Cluster Robust Standard Error
parts:
library(survey)
library(lavaan.survey)
cluster.se <- svydesign( ids~=clustervar, data=mydata)
lavaan.fit <- lavaan( whatever )
lavaan.cluster.se <- lavaan.survey( lavaan.fit=lavaan.fit,
survey.design=cluster.se )
summary( lavaan.cluster.se )
